scope: Public-safe extraction of scientific roles, evidence states, source authority and publication boundaries for WEB-SCIENCE EXT PASS 4. No item banks, scoring keys, thresholds or restricted adjudication records are published here.
evidence_boundary: External publications support adjacent mechanisms, constructs, comparators and measurement precedents. Internal P-120 passes document architecture development and methodological verification. Neither class by itself constitutes empirical psychometric validation of the integrated P-120 system.

source_classes.label: External scientific foundation
source_classes.use: Peer-reviewed literature and methodological standards used as adjacent mechanism, comparator, measurement-precedent or methods evidence.

source_classes.label: P-120 measurement/module authority
source_classes.use: Controlled module-specific decisions on construct territory, candidate architecture, development state and validation gates.

source_classes.label: P-120 cross-system methodological authority
source_classes.use: Ownership, redundancy, information-gain, scope/exposure and cross-module firewall governance.

source_classes.label: WEB-SCIENCE publication architecture
source_classes.use: Controls public projection, visibility and claim ceilings; cannot create scientific status.
